items: Article 8 specifically deals with Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) residing outside undivided India.
Mandatory requirement: Registration with the diplomatic or consular representative of India in the country of residence.
The definition of 'born in India' relies strictly on the Government of India Act, 1935.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 8 governs citizenship rights for Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) residing outside undivided India.
To qualify, the individual, or either of their parents or grandparents, must have been born in India as defined in the Government of India Act, 1935.
Citizenship under this provision requires formal registration by a diplomatic or consular representative of India in the country of residence.
The application for registration could be submitted before or after the commencement of the Constitution of India.
